name: dev.octri/cli
title: Octri CLI
description: Push OpenAPI specs, build SDKs in ten languages, publish API docs, and triage production SDK errors.

environmentVariables.name: OCTRI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Octri API key. Not needed if you have signed in with `octri auth login`.

environmentVariables.name: OCTRI_PROJECT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Project to use when a tool call names none. Defaults to the CLI's selected project.

environmentVariables.name: OCTRI_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Stored CLI profile to use instead of the current one.
